svg.title: Insurge: custom software, against the generic. Orbyta, its product system, drawn as a violet black hole with seven planets in orbit: Heimdall (accounts, 5 moons), Mercúrio (orders, 5 moons), Eco (support, 7 moons), Muninn (tax records, 5 moons), Têmis (freight, 5 moons), Huginn (assistant, 3 moons), Íris (tickets, 4 moons).
